description: Use after start_token_signin, once your wallet has signed the message. Free. Checks the signature and that the address holds an accepted token or name right now, and returns a short-lived `pass` (pp1.…). Give the pass to the gated site the way it asks: sites using the npm package or Cloudflare template take it at POST /api/tokenlock/session ({"pass": "…"}) and set a cookie; your own API can take it in a header and check it with verifyPass. If the site accepts any name, send your name. Single use per challenge. A pass proves you controlled a wallet holding the token at sign-in, not who you are.

name.description: Your vanity name, when the site accepts any name.

signature.description: Base64 signature of the exact message (BIP-322 or legacy sign-message).

name: finish_token_signin
title: Finish a token sign-in (get a pass)
